items.title: 初次见面
items.text: 我是阿贝多，西风骑士团首席炼金术士。我对你身上星海的气息很感兴趣，想要就近观察研究。相信以后我们会有很多独处的机会。
items.text_en: I am Albedo, Chief Alchemist of the Knights of Favonius. You carry the aura of the stars, interesting... I would like to study you, if you do not mind. I'm certain we will have many opportunities to be alone in the future.

items.title: 闲聊·写生
items.text: 风景不错，趁着休息，就把这一幕画下来吧。
items.text_en: What a view... How about a quick break so I can sketch this beautiful scenery?

items.title: 闲聊·探究
items.text: 「世界的真相」…究竟是什么呢？
items.text_en: "The truth of this world"... *sigh* What could it be?

items.title: 闲聊·怀旧
items.text: 用自己的双脚丈量土地，将「未知」变为知识。…这种感觉，真怀念啊。
items.text_en: Going out into the world and investigating, turning the "unknown" into the "known." ...Ahhh, I missed this feeling.

items.title: 下雨的时候
items.text: 土壤湿润，适合采集爆爆瓜的根。没事，我来动手就可以。
items.text_en: The soil is moist, ideal for collecting the roots of Boom Blossoms. No please, allow me to handle this.

items.title: 下雪的时候
items.text: 师父…
items.text_en: Master...

items.title: 阳光很好
items.text: 光线充足，生物行为活跃，嗯，很适合写生。
items.text_en: Ample light... active biological organisms... Yes, this is a good place to sketch.

items.title: 早上好
items.text: 早安，是准备出门寻找古代遗物吗？
items.text_en: Good morning. Are we going to search for ancient relics today?

items.title: 中午好
items.text: 午安，我听到了你的脚步声。工坊之外真是热闹啊。
items.text_en: Good afternoon. I heard your footsteps. My, it certainly is lively outside of the workshop.

items.title: 晚上好
items.text: 外面安静下来了，呼。
items.text_en: *sigh* It's gotten quiet outside...

items.title: 晚安
items.text: 晚安，你先去休息吧，我打算把最后一个实验做完。既然你那么感兴趣…明日再会时，我再与你一起探讨实验结果吧。
items.text_en: Good night, you go ahead and rest. I will just finish one last experiment before bed... If you are interested in the results, I can discuss them with you tomorrow.

items.title: 关于阿贝多自己·天才
items.text: 天才？…不少人这么称呼我。其实，我不这样认为。
items.text_en: Genius? ...A number of people call me that. But I don't think I'm any "genius."

items.title: 关于阿贝多自己·人际
items.text: 与人交往…很麻烦。一旦开始就要不断维持，如果联系中断了，想再重新恢复，就得消耗更多的时间。
items.text_en: Relationships are... *sigh* quite troublesome. Once you establish a relation with someone, you must continue to maintain it; if you lose contact, you must reestablish the relation. This taxing cycle requires...a lot of time.

items.title: 关于我们·实验
items.text: 你…这是准备陪我做实验吗？呼，真荣幸。啊，不用紧张。我的实验虽然危险，通常不会伤及无辜。
items.text_en: You... want to accompany me while I experiment? I'm honored.Oh, don't be nervous. My experiments may be dangerous, but no one gets hurt... most of the time.

items.title: 关于我们·助手
items.text: 能麻烦你当我的助手吗？鉴于你旁观了那么多次，想必早就熟练了吧。放心，我在你旁边。就算是第一次实际操作，也不会有问题的。我相信我的指导能力，更相信你的天赋。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Would you oblige me by serving as my assistant? After observing so many experiments, you surely know a good deal about alchemy by now. Relax, we will work together. I don't think you will have any problems. I have faith in my ability to instruct you, and even more faith in your exceptional talents.

items.title: 关于「神之眼」
items.text: 「神之眼」？不过就是个实验用的工具罢了，和烧杯、坩埚没什么不同。唯一让我感兴趣的，就是它的原理…我总有一天会研究明白的，这只是时间问题。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4My Vision? Ah, that's nothing more than a tool to aid in my experiments, no different from a beaker or crucible. The one thing about it that really intrigues me is the principle behind how it works... One day, I will uncover its secrets. It's only a matter of time.

items.title: 有什么想要分享
items.text: 一直有些难以开口，因为假设被你拒绝的话，我可能会失落吧…嗯…我对你身边那个飞着的小家伙很感兴趣，方便让我拿去研究一下吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4There's something I've always wanted to ask you, but feared rejection and disappointment...Ahem... I am very interested in your... little floating companion. May I borrow her to investigate for a short while?

items.title: 感兴趣的见闻
items.text: 想知道更多石化古树的事情？唔…你在附近秘境里观测到的那些，其实不算古老。稍微成熟一些的树，一般能长到两三公里高；在树的根部，常常聚集着一种大蜘蛛。那种蜘蛛啊，用地栀子和香茅草捆紧，抹上白豆蔻，熏烤上几个小时，那香味，是真的很…令我难忘。
items.text_en: You would like to know more about petrified trees? Um... ahem. Actually, the petrified trees you have come across in domains aren't that ancient. Truly ancient trees usually grow to around one or two miles in height? Oh, and there's a kind of large spider that lives around their roots — if you tie one up in cape jasmine and lemongrass and sprinkle on some cardamom, smoke it for a few hours — you get a fragrant taste that's simply... unforgettable.

items.title: 关于亲人
items.text: 亲人吗？虽然艾莉丝总希望我喊她妈妈…唔，但在我心里，谈起亲人第一时间想到的还是师父吧。我从记事起就和她在一起探险了，她教会了我炼金术和无数世间的知识。或许…「亲人」或者「师父」，这些词汇都不足以描绘出她对我来说的意义吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Family? Although Alice has always asked me to call her "Mother," when I think of the idea of "family," my master comes to mind first. My earliest memories in life are of going on adventures with her. She taught me the art of alchemy and much knowledge about the world. Perhaps... even the words "family" and "master" are incapable of fully expressing her meaning to me.

items.title: 关于砂糖·方向
items.text: 砂糖吗？我大概能理解她一心专攻「生物炼金」的理由…不管怎样，看到她的研究越来越顺利，我也为她感到高兴。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Sucrose? I think I more or less understand why she is so dedicated to her research in bio-alchemy... Either way, I'm happy to see her succeed more and more in her endeavors.

items.title: 关于砂糖·坚持
items.text: 虽然在学术方面的合作非常愉快，但课题以外的部分，砂糖也有很多她自己的坚持。比如我告诉她我们是平辈，叫我阿贝多就好，她却坚持要用尊称。…只好随她去了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5Working with Sucrose on alchemy research is quite pleasant, but she has some... stubborn qualities in regards to certain aspects unrelated to research. For example, I have told her numerous times to just call me "Albedo" since we are about the same age, but she insists on addressing me in an excessively formal manner. *sigh* ...Whatever she prefers, I guess.

items.title: 关于丽莎
items.text: 丽莎吗？和她讨论总会得到很有价值的观点。如此有才华却满足于图书管理员一职，想必背后藏着与那才华等重的因缘吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Lisa? I always am impressed by the valuable perspectives she brings to discussions. But is a person with her talents satisfied with such a basic occupation as librarian? There must be some hidden reason for this.

items.title: 关于可莉
items.text: 我的确把可莉当作亲妹妹一样看，所以每次当这位妹妹惹出麻烦的时候，我都只能安慰自己，至少她现在的破坏力，还不及艾莉丝女士的零头。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Indeed, I view Klee as my younger sister. Whenever she gets herself into some explosive sort of trouble, I can only console myself with the fact that her current destructiveness is nothing compared to that of Miss Alice.

items.title: 关于琴
items.text: 琴吗？她是一位正直的代理团长，甚至可以说比那位团长大人更为可靠。可能大家心中都在期待着她成为正式团长的那一天吧。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Jean? She has served exceptionally well as Acting Grand Master. One can even say she is more reliable than Grand Master Varka. Perhaps in our hearts, we all eagerly await the day she can become the official Grand Master herself.

items.title: 关于行秋
items.text: 行秋吗？他写的小说挺有趣的。稻妻那边的「八重堂」一直在旁敲侧击希望让我和别的作者合作，说这样版税收入也会更好。哼，我缺这点钱吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Oh, Xingqiu? I find his written works quite interesting. The Yae Publishing House in Inazuma has been asking that I cooperate with a different author for greater royalties. Hmph, do I seem the type to be swayed by a few extra Mora?

items.title: 关于芭芭拉
items.text: 芭芭拉吗？她是一位认真的牧师，说来以前碰巧有机会给她画过速写…你问画哪儿去了？嗯…我拒绝了艾伯特的开价，直接把画送给了代理团长。人际交往…真是耗费精力啊。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4Barbara? She's a very earnest Deaconess. I once had the opportunity to sketch her a simple portrait... What happened to the sketch? Ah yes... Albert offered to purchase it, but I rejected his bid and gave it to the Acting Grand Master. Social relations... really require a lot of effort.

items.title: 想要了解阿贝多·其一
items.text: 有问题想问我？请说吧。啊，冒昧地问一句，应该不会花费太长时间吧？手头的研究马上要进入最后一个阶段了。
items.text_en: Have a question for me? Go ahead, ask. It doesn't take too long to ask a single question, does it? I'm about to begin the final stage of an experiment...

items.title: 想要了解阿贝多·其二
items.text: 啊，只是随口一提。不人为介入的话，黄金需要杀死一个八倍大的太阳才能自然生成。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 3Oh, by the way. Did you know that without human manipulation, you would need to harness the power of a sun eight times the size of our own in order to naturally create gold?

items.title: 想要了解阿贝多·其三
items.text: 人物画的耗时主要和心情有关。有时候霍夫曼我也能画半天，有时候凯亚都只需要三笔——这个圆是脸，这个是眼罩的带子…这个是眼罩。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 4The time required to sketch portraits closely correlates with one's mood. I could spend half a day sketching Huffman, while I might only need three strokes of the pencil to sketch Kaeya — one for the face, one for the eyepatch string... and one for the eyepatch.

items.title: 想要了解阿贝多·其四
items.text: 除了画画和研究之外的生活…我偶尔会去看稻妻和璃月的小说吧，能看到很多很有趣的想法，有时也会为创作提供意想不到的灵感。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 5What do I do besides sketching and research...? I will occasionally read novels from Inazuma and Liyue. They contain many fascinating ideas which can sometimes provide me with unexpected inspirations for my own creations.

items.title: 想要了解阿贝多·其五
items.text: 即便到了现在，师父传授给我的「黑土之术」仍是充满了谜团，师父到底想要用这个技术创造出什么呢？…研究之期还远未到尽头，得麻烦你和我一起继续探索了。
items.text_en: Unlocks at Friendship Lv. 6Even now, I find the nigredo processing stage of alchemy passed down by my master to be full of mystery. What did my master want to create using this technique...? My research is far from over. I will require your help to investigate further.

items.title: 阿贝多的爱好
items.text: 嗯…研究之外我最愿意花时间去做的应该是画画吧。一开始只是为了理解物体与材料的构成，便于研究开展，不过到了后来就变成了爱好。嗯，也是一种很好的放松方式。
items.text_en: Hmm... Besides research, the activity I spend most of my time on is probably sketching. At first I saw it simply as a way to better study the structure of living things and materials so as to aid me in my experiments, but it eventually became a hobby of mine. Indeed, it is a very good way to relax.

items.title: 阿贝多的烦恼
items.text: 时间真是不够用啊，即使把大部分麻烦的事情都推掉还是会觉得时间不够。
items.text_en: There's just never enough time, is there? Even when I remove the most troublesome matters from my schedule, I still can't find enough time for everything.

items.title: 喜欢的食物
items.text: 我挺喜欢甜点的。怎么说呢…在体力和精力同时消耗殆尽的时候，高能量的物质会提供原始而高效的支持吧。
items.text_en: I really do enjoy having dessert. How can I put it...? When both physical and mental capacity are spent, high-energy materials further provide a kind of primordial, highly-effective boost.

items.title: 讨厌的食物
items.text: 讨厌的食物？餐馆里分量比较大的肉吧。我的胃口吃不了多少，只会面临「浪费」或者「失去风味」的结局。后来我就干脆不去餐馆了，虽然这也意味着要花更多时间在做菜上…
items.text_en: What food do I dislike? ...Large portions of meat at restaurants. I have a rather small appetite, so a meal like that only ends up in tragedy — either I overeat and the joy of the taste is lost, or I don't finish it and the food is wasted. I decided to simply not go to restaurants, although that has also meant I must spend more time preparing my own food...

items.title: 收到赠礼·其一
items.text: 味觉仿佛折射出了色彩…我想它是金色的。
items.text_en: If flavors were colors... this one would be gold.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其二
items.text: 你似乎很愿意花时间在做菜上，所以才能做出这样的味道。
items.text_en: You're willing to spend so much time on improving your cooking, and that's precisely how you're able to make it taste so good.

items.title: 收到赠礼·其三
items.text: 量有点大…要一起分享吗？
items.text_en: This is more than I can manage... maybe we could split it between us?

items.title: 生日
items.text: 生日快乐。你看起来很高兴，可以将你的样子画下来吗？大脑的容量是有限的，人总会不断忘记。如果画在纸上，那么这些画就成了记忆的延伸，在未来重新看到这些画面时，一定能回想起当时的感觉吧。
items.text_en: Happy birthday. You look especially happy, would you mind if I sketched you? The capacity of our brains is limited, so we are bound to forget things. But when an image is transferred onto paper or canvas, the sketch becomes an extension of our memory. We can remember that past feeling when we later look at the sketch.

items.title: 突破的感受·起
items.text: 「黑土」，是炼金术的词源，也是最初的状态。活在这个世界上，我等俗类必须寻找意义。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 1Nigredo is the first step in alchemy, drawing from primordial forms. As beings who live in this world, we must find our own meaning.

items.title: 突破的感受·承
items.text: 「白垩」，即是变化的开始。抽离了杂质，准备好接受一切知识。要和我一起去探索世界吗？
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 2Albedo is the step in which change begins. Clearing away the excess so we can take on all the knowledge that is available. Would you like to investigate this world with me?

items.title: 突破的感受·转
items.text: 「赤成」，炼金术中的意思是，情感的炼化。我的赤色好像来自于你。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 4Rubedo in alchemy refers to the refining of feeling. I feel the refining of my own emotions is also thanks to you.

items.title: 突破的感受·合
items.text: 「黄金」，炼金术最后的阶段。无价值的事物终于找到了自己的意义，变化成了黄金。我，也找到了意义。
items.text_en: Unlocks at ascension phase 6Citrinitas is the final stage of the alchemical transmutation process. The meaning of the object being transmuted has finally been brought to light, becoming gold and revealing its true value... I too have found my own meaning.

items.title: 元素战技·其一
items.text: 绽放吧。
items.text_en: Burst forth.

items.title: 元素战技·其二
items.text: 拟造阳华。
items.text_en: Come into being!

items.title: 元素战技·其三
items.text: 创生之法。
items.text_en: Live.

items.title: 元素爆发·其一
items.text: 此即，诞生之刻。
items.text_en: Moment of birth.

items.title: 元素爆发·其二
items.text: 冥古，于此显生。
items.text_en: Feel this ancient power.

items.title: 元素爆发·其三
items.text: 见证伟业吧。
items.text_en: Witness my great undertaking.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其一
items.text: 大地的秘宝。
items.text_en: This world holds many a rare treasure.

items.title: 打开宝箱·其二
items.text: 无言的叙事。
items.text_en: If this treasure could talk...

items.title: 打开宝箱·其三
items.text: 虽无法比拟「黄金」，但终有价值。
items.text_en: Although it's not gold, it certainly glitters.

items.title: 生命值低·其一
items.text: 计算失误…
items.text_en: My calculations were off...

items.title: 生命值低·其二
items.text: 需要重新评估…
items.text_en: Time to reassess...

items.title: 生命值低·其三
items.text: 必须改变策略。
items.text_en: A new strategy's required.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其一
items.text: 交给我吧。
items.text_en: I'll take over from here.

items.title: 同伴生命值低·其二
items.text: 换人，对你来说太危险了。
items.text_en: This is too dangerous for you.

items.title: 倒下·其一
items.text: 尘归尘，土归土…
items.text_en: Ashes to ashes, dust to dust...

items.title: 倒下·其二
items.text: 实验失败了吗？
items.text_en: My... experiment... failed...

items.title: 倒下·其三
items.text: 我的研究，结束了…
items.text_en: Seems my research... is over...

items.title: 普通受击·其一
items.text: 阈值以内…
items.text_en: Still within my threshold.

items.title: 重受击·其一
items.text: 失算了…
items.text_en: A miscalculation...

items.title: 加入队伍·其一
items.text: 了解。
items.text_en: Understood.

items.title: 加入队伍·其二
items.text: 是拓展课题吗？
items.text_en: Some in-the-field research?

items.title: 加入队伍·其三
items.text: 一起探索吧。
items.text_en: Let's investigate this further.
